services.name: Self Guided Tours
services.desc: Fresno Flats Park is open daily from dusk to dawn for self-guided tours of the exterior of our historic buildings. The kioske has a map for you to use and the Taylor Cabin and Laurimore House have a push button recording available to provide more information. Tours of the museum and building interiors and the gift shop are open Saturdays 11AM to 4PM. Tours can be available on other days by appointment. Please email us for Group tour arrangements. © 2026 Sierra Historic Sites Association - Website Development by Moss Web

services.name: Vacation Rental
services.desc: Stay in our 2-guest Silver Knob Cabin, an authentic log cabin from the 1880s, located within the Fresno Flats Historic Village and Park. The cabin is a blend of rustic comfort and rich history for travelers seeking relaxation and charm, and located only 16 miles from Yosemite’s south entrance. Our cabin offers modern amenities while retaining its 19th-century charm. Your stay also goes to preserving history, as the funds raised from the rental help support the historic park and museum. We provide self check-in with a secure keypad. Free on-premises parking in the lot. Guests are welcome to use the park and take self-guided tours. blurb: Fresno Flats is located in Oakhurst, California just 20 minutes south of Yosemite National Park. This park and museum uniquely recapture life in California’s “wild west” in the late 1800s, which includes several pioneer homes, two one-room schoolhouses, two jails, a blacksmith shop, a print shop, gift shop, wagon display, and a portion of the historic lumber flume.
